orig.gloss: and/ I will turn around/ you
orig.il: And I will turn thee back
and I will bring thee forth
with them; all of them with shield
for thyself, thou, and all thy company
unto thee, and be thou a guard
thou shalt be like a cloud
to them that are at rest
with thee, all of them riding
it shall be in the latter
me, when I shall be sanctified
thou he of whom I have spoken
And it shall come to pass at the same time

orig.gloss: and/ they will be thrown down

orig.il: against him throughout all my mountains

orig.gloss: and/ I will enter into judgment

orig.il: upon him, and upon his bands

orig.gloss: and/ I will show myself great
and/ I will show myself holy
and/ I will make myself known
orig.il: myself; and I will be known
